main.summary: Maintains the selected storage silo for the current tenant transfer request and resolves transfer storage instances.

property.name: CatalogName
property.summary: Gets the catalog name for the current transfer request.
property.exception: The storage silo has not been selected.

method.name: Set
method.summary: Selects the storage silo used to resolve tenant transfer storage.
method.param: Storage silo selected for the current transfer request.

method.name: Get
method.summary: Creates tenant transfer storage for a session, item, and item instance using the selected storage silo.
method.param: Item instance token used to isolate the staging paths.
method.returns: Storage for the specified transfer session, item, and item instance.
method.exception: The storage silo has not been selected.
